# Cheat sheet {#sec-cheatsheet}

```bash
## setup (once)
conda create -n sra -c conda-forge -c bioconda sra-tools pigz; conda activate sra   # or: module load <sra module>
vdb-config --prefetch-to-cwd          # downloads go to the current folder
vdb-config -i                         # interactive: SRA Lite vs Normalized, locations
fastq-dump --stdout -X 2 SRR390728    # test

## folders: scripts once, one folder per dataset, run everything from the dataset folder
git clone https://github.com/jpflores-13/download-public-data.git ~/download-public-data
mkdir -p ~/public_data/<GSE> && cd ~/public_data/<GSE>       # cluster: in scratch
mv ~/Downloads/SRR_Acc_List.txt ~/Downloads/SraRunTable.csv .  # from Run Selector
# cluster, run ON YOUR LAPTOP: scp ~/Downloads/{SRR_Acc_List.txt,SraRunTable.csv} <user>@<cluster>:<scratch>/public_data/<GSE>/
wc -l SRR_Acc_List.txt; head -2 SraRunTable.csv                 # check

## metadata
## Run Selector: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Traces/study/?acc=<GSE or PRJNA>
curl -s "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/filereport?accession=<ACC>&result=read_run&fields=run_accession,sample_title,library_layout,read_count,fastq_ftp,fastq_md5&format=tsv"
esearch -db sra -query <PRJNA> | efetch -format runinfo > runinfo.csv

## one run
prefetch SRR... --max-size u -O sra
vdb-validate sra/SRR...
fasterq-dump sra/SRR... --threads 6 --temp tmp --outdir fastq
pigz -p 6 fastq/SRR...*.fastq

## many runs: loop (any computer)
while read -r a; do prefetch "$a" --max-size u -O sra && fasterq-dump "sra/$a" -e 4 -t tmp -O fastq && pigz fastq/"$a"*.fastq && rm -rf "sra/$a"; done < SRR_Acc_List.txt

## many runs: SLURM array job
mkdir -p logs
sbatch --array=1-$(grep -c . SRR_Acc_List.txt)%4 ~/download-public-data/scripts/download_sra.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq

## many runs: one job per run, then retry what failed
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/submit_each.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq            # CONVERTER=parallel to use parallel-fastq-dump
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/find_missing.sh SRR_Acc_List.txt fastq > failed.txt
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/submit_each.sh failed.txt fastq                  # repeat until failed.txt is empty

## parallel-fastq-dump (gzip built in, less temp space)
parallel-fastq-dump --sra-id sra/SRR... --threads 4 --outdir fastq --tmpdir tmp --split-3 --gzip

## from ENA instead
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/ena_download.sh <ACC> fastq

## check and organise
for f in fastq/*.fastq.gz; do gzip -t "$f" || echo "BROKEN $f"; done
cat fastq/read_counts.tsv
bash ~/download-public-data/scripts/merge_runs.sh runs_to_samples.tsv fastq merged

## quick peek without downloading everything
fastq-dump -X 1000 --split-3 SRR...      # first 1000 spots
vdb-dump --info SRR...                   # size and details
```
